# nb1: local blink(1) control

Discover actual CLI help or MCP tools/list before use; source support does not prove installed support. This index grants no additional permissions.

## Contract

- High-level Action: set, off, fade, blink, breathe, pulse, alternate, orbit, rainbow.
- Low-level Sequence: timing serial or interval, ordered steps[], ColorInput target colors resolved to lowercase Hex6 by the core, integer millisecond durations, repeat and on_finish. The nb1 core compiles and schedules playback.
- ColorInput: names, Hex3/6, RGB8, HSV (HSB in the UI) and explicit local @name references. No implicit gamma.
- Pattern: a computer-side saved normalized Sequence, independent of device storage generation.
- DeviceSequence: native RAM/Flash semantics with separate capabilities and deployment. Saving a host Pattern does not deploy it to hardware.

## Execution

HTTP POST /v1/preview compiles action, sequence or pattern_id without playing. POST /v1/jobs accepts the same expression plus serial and optional id. GET /v1/jobs/{id} tracks it; POST /v1/jobs/{id}/cancel requests cancellation.

MCP is real stdio to local HTTP, without a CLI subprocess or USB ownership. HTTP CLI calls and the embedded Web use the running daemon. MCP selects its endpoint with --endpoint, defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8931 and does not read nb1 YAML; the HTTP CLI can derive its endpoint from profile server.listen. Point all clients at the intended daemon. An unavailable daemon never triggers an automatic start or USB fallback.

For daemon submissions, preserve endpoint, serial, input and Job ID. Omitted or empty IDs use j_ plus ten random Base32 characters. HTTP CLI and MCP generate IDs before sending. Accepted is not completed: query the original Job until terminal. HTTP client timeout or MCP closure does not cancel an accepted Job. On uncertainty, query the same ID without replaying. A missing record cannot prove nothing executed.

Matching ID, serial and input is deduplicated while retained. Active Jobs stay pinned. Terminal cache defaults are 30 minutes and 16,384 entries, configurable through jobs.terminal_ttl and jobs.terminal_limit. Reads do not renew expiration. Capacity eviction or daemon restart can remove records earlier. A lost record permits the ID to execute again, so do not infer permanent deduplication.

Only nb1 control --direct run [SERIAL] FILE supports foreground direct Action/Sequence/Pattern execution. It uses local compilation and the local library, always waits, rejects --id, and starts no HTTP server. Its Job belongs only to that process, with no HTTP lookup or cross-process deduplication. There is no default total deadline; explicit --timeout requests cancellation and cleanup with a separate bounded context. Ctrl-C requests cancellation and cleanup too. Inspect exit status and JSON fields mode, job, and engine_closed: engine_closed alone proves neither success nor an extinguished light. A successful hold can leave color behind. Never apply daemon Job recovery or automatic replay to an uncertain direct result.

Use nb1 config path and nb1 config show to inspect settings without USB. Profile and default-library roots use XDG_CONFIG_HOME/nb1 or ~/.config/nb1 on macOS/Linux, and native user configuration on Windows. Device ownership locks keep the native platform root independently of the profile/library; all owners must agree on any lock-directory override.

## References

- [OpenAPI 3.1](docs/api-v1.openapi.json): current machine-readable HTTP contract.
- [API v1](docs/api-v1.md): HTTP/CLI contract, colors, Patterns and limits.
- [Terminology](docs/api-v1-terminology.md): Action, Sequence, Step, Job, Pattern and DeviceSequence.
- [Agent skill](skills/blink1-control/SKILL.md): expression selection, tracking and recovery.
- [Agent setup and use](docs/agent-guide.md): project-local discovery, explicit invocation and documentation routing.
- [Local library](skills/blink1-control/references/patterns.md): named colors and saved Patterns.
- [MCP adapter](adapters/mcp/README.md): build, transport and tool schemas.
- [Codex turn notifications](examples/command-notify/CODEX.md): external notify argv JSON and stdin Stop are separate entries; preview by default, explicitly execute one finite blue turn-ended Job, and preserve the original Job ID without replay after uncertainty. One-invocation setup does not install global hooks.

Report preview, terminal status, timestamped RGB readback and camera observation separately. Mac/MK2 evidence does not establish MK3, other-OS USB or optical quality. Public interfaces default to English and offer Chinese where available. Do not change global MCP registration, startup services or system permissions just to use this project.
